description: Original invented conversations. No source client records or audio. Morning original is separately preserved byte-for-byte.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Can I ask about a consultation over a lease deposit before I send any papers?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Yes. Reception can explain how to request one; please do not send papers yet.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: My reminder has no floor number. Where should I go?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Reception is on the second floor. The entrance has the office name beside it.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I mailed an envelope yesterday. Can you see it?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: It is not in today's reception log. That does not tell us where the mail is.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Do I need an appointment just to collect a blank intake form?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: You may collect a blank form at reception during opening hours.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: The form asks for a middle name, but I don't have one.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Leave that space blank rather than adding a name you do not use.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Is this the county clerk?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: No, this is a private law office. We cannot check the clerk's records here.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I am Nora Bell. Is the side entrance the public one?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Please use the front entrance; the side door is for deliveries.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: ¿Puedo pedir información sin dar mi número de expediente?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Sí, para explicar cómo solicitar una cita no necesitamos ese número.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I am Evan Reed. Is an initial appointment automatically an agreement to take my matter?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: No. Asking for an appointment does not establish that the lawyer will take a matter.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Can I bring my notes on paper instead of emailing them?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: You can bring paper notes to your consultation. Keep your own copy.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I cannot open the attachment with the directions.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: The street entrance is beside the blue awning. I can read the directions now.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Is a bank statement the same as the receipt you asked for?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: I cannot determine which document the lawyer meant without the request in front of us.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: The message says to call reception. Does that mean there is a problem?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: That wording alone does not explain the reason. I do not have another note here.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: My name is Tessa Vale. Please ask the lawyer to call about the draft.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: What question should the message include?

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Whether the last paragraph reflects what we discussed. I am not asking you to change it.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Do you have evening appointments listed today?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: The list available to reception has no evening slot today.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Soy Ana Cruz. ¿La cita por teléfono necesita una aplicación?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: No para una llamada telefónica normal; esta conversación no confirma qué formato tiene su cita.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Can my sister pick up a sealed envelope for me?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Reception needs to check the collection authorization first. I cannot approve that from this call.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I found the office hours on the door. Are those the reception hours?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Yes, those are the hours for the reception desk.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I saved the appointment message but not the address. Can you read it to me?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: The address is printed at the top of the message; look above the appointment line.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I see it now.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: The questionnaire won't let me type an accent in my name.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Write your name correctly on the printed copy and mention the electronic form issue at reception.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Does dropping off a document mean it has been reviewed that day?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: No. Reception can record receipt, but cannot confirm legal review.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I have two copies with different dates. Which should I bring?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Bring both if you want the lawyer to compare them. I cannot decide which is controlling.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Was the office closed July third for the holiday?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: The synthetic office schedule marks July third as closed.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I am Colin Webb. The receipt lists two pages, but I left three.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: I will ask reception to check the page count against the envelope log.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: ¿Puedo llevar mis preguntas escritas en español?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Sí, puede llevarlas. Eso no confirma la disponibilidad de interpretación para una cita.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I accidentally called the number on an old business card. Is reception still here?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: You have reached reception for this office.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Could you tell me what a consultation about a simple will costs?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: I do not have an approved fee quote for your proposed appointment. I cannot give a price on this call.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I need to reschedule but don't know my work shifts yet.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Call when you know the times you can attend; we have not changed your appointment in this conversation.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: My name is Willa Kent. I found the receipt, so there is no need to look for another copy.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Understood. You are saying the copy request is no longer needed.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Can I leave papers through the door after closing?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: There is no reception handover after closing. Please arrange a drop-off while the desk is open.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: The intake sheet asks for a case number I don't have.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Do not guess a number. You can mark that field as unknown.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I got a voicemail but only heard the end.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: I cannot reconstruct the missing part from what you heard. Do you have the original message saved?

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: No, I deleted it.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Soy Bruno Díaz. ¿Recibir un documento significa que ya aceptaron mi asunto?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: No, la recepción del documento no confirma que el abogado acepte el asunto.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Can I pay a consultation fee in advance by this phone call?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Reception cannot collect payment details on this line. We have not taken a payment.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I am June Ellis. Please have the lawyer explain a phrase in the letter.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Which phrase?

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: The part about returning a signed copy. I don't know whether it applies to me.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Is a photograph of the envelope useful, or only the letter?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Keep both available for the lawyer to decide what is needed.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: My appointment card has a handwritten correction. Can reception verify it?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: I cannot read that correction over the phone. Bring the card when you ask us to check the list.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I received the new directions. That is all I was waiting for.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Good, you have the directions now.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Do you notarize documents for people who are not clients?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: I cannot confirm that service from the reception information available today.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: The appointment email says to arrive early. How early?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: It gives no number of minutes, so I cannot infer one from that sentence.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: ¿Puedo pedir una copia en papel de las instrucciones?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: En recepción hay instrucciones impresas; puede recoger una copia.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I am Priya Shah. The attachment arrived this time and opens correctly.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Thank you for confirming; you are not requesting another resend.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Correct.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Can reception tell me whether the lawyer has read my note?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: The delivery log shows arrival only. It has no review status.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: My printer cuts off the signature line. Is the partial page enough?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: I cannot approve a cut-off page. Try printing the complete page before asking the lawyer about signing.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Is there a place to sit while I wait for my appointment?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: There are seats in reception.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I am Felix Shaw. You said the envelope was ready, but I did not collect it.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: I will check whether it is still held at reception and leave a note for the lawyer.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Can a consultation about a contractor invoice happen by telephone if I cannot travel?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: You can request that format. We have not confirmed a telephone appointment here.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I have the wrong extension. Could you give legal advice about a traffic ticket?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Reception cannot give legal advice. This call has not been transferred to a lawyer.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: The envelope label has my old surname. Will that prevent a receipt?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Tell reception both names at handover so the receipt can identify what was delivered.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I am Dana Pike. Please call me about whether another appointment is needed.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: I can take that question, but I cannot answer it from the calendar alone.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: ¿Hay que enviar originales para preguntar por una consulta?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: No envíe originales solo para preguntar cómo pedir una consulta.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I called earlier about the office sign. I have found the entrance now.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Then the entrance question is resolved.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Yes, I am at reception.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: The automated reminder repeated twice. Do I have two appointments?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Two reminders alone do not establish two bookings. I cannot verify your calendar entry without your details.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: My name is Leo Finch. May I ask for a fresh copy of the blank questionnaire?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Blank copies are at reception; this is not a completed copy from your file.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I want to cancel an inquiry I left, not an appointment.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Those are different requests. You have not identified an appointment to cancel here.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I am Ruth Ellis. The envelope receipt is enough for my records.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Understood; you are not asking us to certify its contents.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Can I record the consultation on my own phone?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: You would need to ask the lawyer before any recording. Reception cannot approve it.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: The form asks for employer details but I am retired.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: You can state that you are retired; do not supply a current employer you do not have.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Soy Elena Paz. No encuentro el enlace de mi cita.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: No puedo confirmar el enlace sin saber si la cita es presencial o remota.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: No recuerdo el formato.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I am Grant Hale. Would the lawyer call about the document title that does not match the cover note?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Tell me the two titles.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I do not have the papers here; I can explain when he calls.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Can I ask where to put the attention line on an envelope?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Put it above the office address so reception can see it.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Does reception accept a courier signature?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Reception can acknowledge a physical delivery; that does not acknowledge any legal meaning of its contents.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I wrote the wrong month on my notes. Should I erase it?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Keep the original note and make the correction visible for the lawyer to understand.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: My email says the meeting is provisional. Is it confirmed?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Provisional is not confirmation. I cannot turn that wording into a confirmed booking.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I am Mae Rowan. Please ask whether the lawyer received my question about the second page.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Reception has your question in the message log, but that does not establish that the lawyer read it.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: ¿Puedo recoger el formulario sin completarlo allí?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Sí, puede llevarse el formulario en blanco y completarlo después.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I only need to know whether reception is open at lunch.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: The posted reception schedule does not list a separate lunch closure.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I am Owen Park. Could I have the appointment date read slowly?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: The card you are reading says July twenty-second.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Thank you, I can make out that date now.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I found a loose page in the envelope. Can you identify it from the heading?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: A heading alone may not identify the document. Keep the page with the envelope for review.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Does completing the questionnaire reserve an appointment?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: No appointment has been reserved just by filling out that form.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I am Iris Glen. I need the lawyer to call about a message I cannot understand.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Which part is unclear?

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Whether I should bring the old version as well as the new one.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: The photocopier made everything double-sided. Is that a problem for drop-off?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Reception can receive the pages, but cannot decide whether the format is suitable for the lawyer's purpose.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Is there a deadline hidden in the appointment reminder?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: I cannot infer a legal deadline from an appointment reminder.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Soy Marta León. Ya encontré la copia que buscaba.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Entonces no necesita que recepción busque otra.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Exacto, solo llamaba para aclararlo.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I want to bring a support person. Is that allowed automatically?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Please raise that before the consultation; reception cannot give automatic permission.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: My name is Simon Oak. I left a folder with a green elastic band.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: I will check the reception shelf against the handover log before giving a collection answer.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Can I ask for a consultation about a fence dispute if I don't know the other person's address?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: You may ask how to request a consultation; do not invent missing details on the form.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: The desk told me to keep the receipt. Do you mean the postage receipt?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: I cannot tell which receipt that earlier speaker meant from this description.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I am Bea Frost. The message was for someone else with a similar name.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Thank you for telling reception. We cannot discuss another person's message with you.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Do you accept walk-ins for legal questions?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Reception cannot promise access to the lawyer without an arranged appointment.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Could you spell the word questionnaire on the form title?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Q-u-e-s-t-i-o-n-n-a-i-r-e.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: That matches the form I have.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: ¿El recibo indica que revisaron todas las páginas?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: No, indica recepción, no revisión de cada página.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I am Nina Brook. Please ask the lawyer to explain why there are two signature boxes.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: I can record that question. I cannot say which box you should sign.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I received a reminder while I was away. Is it okay to reply with my availability?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: You can give reception your available times, but a reply alone is not a confirmed reschedule.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Does the blank form need blue ink?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: No ink-color instruction is shown on the blank form available here.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I have a question about an invoice number, but I have not brought the invoice.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Without the invoice number we cannot identify which invoice you mean in this call.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I am Paul Alder. The scanned page is sideways, not missing.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Thanks for clarifying the problem. A sideways page is different from an absent page.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: If I arrive early, may I leave the documents and come back for the appointment?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: You can ask reception to record a drop-off; that does not change the appointment time.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Soy Tomás Vega. ¿Se puede confirmar una cita con solo mi apellido?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: No puedo identificar una cita de forma segura solo con ese dato.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I am Ada Birch. You were going to confirm which envelope is mine.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: I will compare the labels with the collection record; I have not completed that check yet.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: My notes refer to next Tuesday, but I wrote them last month.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: That relative date cannot be resolved from today's date alone. Keep the original note date with it.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Can reception explain the difference between a copy and a certified copy?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: I can tell you they are not interchangeable terms, but the lawyer needs to say which is needed.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Is a consultation request the same as opening a file?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: We have not confirmed a file opening merely because you asked for a consultation.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I found the appointment card under my papers. I don't need another reminder.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Understood; you have the card now. We have not changed reminder settings in this call.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I am Hugo Field. Please call me when someone can explain the reference on this cover sheet.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: What reference?

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: It ends in a letter, but I cannot read the number clearly.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Does the office keep spare blank envelopes?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Reception has plain envelopes for document drop-off.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I wrote on the back of the page. Should I tell reception?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Yes, mention that there is writing on both sides when you hand it over.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: ¿Necesito traducir mi pregunta para llamar a recepción?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Puede hacer su pregunta en español; si no la entendemos, lo diremos en vez de adivinar.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I am Cora Hill. I want to check the spelling on my envelope before it is logged.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Please read it at reception during handover. We have not corrected a label over this call.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Could I have a duplicate receipt stamped as an original?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Reception cannot describe a duplicate as an original.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Is the lawyer in court today?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Reception cannot confirm the lawyer's whereabouts from the information on this screen.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I am Noel West. The cover email and attachment have different names.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: I will ask reception to check what was sent before saying which document it should contain.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: The page numbers skip from two to four. Does that mean page three is missing?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: It may be a numbering issue or a missing page; I cannot resolve it without the set.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Can I leave my only copy at reception?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Keep a copy for yourself if possible; reception cannot decide whether your only copy should be surrendered.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I am Lila Moss. Please ask the lawyer whether the new address changes the letter.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: I cannot answer the effect of an address change. Your question is about the letter, correct?

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Yes.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: ¿Una llamada perdida significa que debo ir hoy?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: No podemos inferir una cita o una instrucción de acudir solo por una llamada perdida.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: The appointment line says room pending. Where should I wait?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Start at reception; the room has not been specified in that message.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I asked for directions, but I meant the mailing address, not driving directions.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: The mailing address appears on the office letterhead. Use that rather than interpreting driving directions.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I am Ellis Snow. The courier says delivered but I have no office receipt.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: A courier status and our reception receipt are separate records. I cannot confirm our receipt from that status alone.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Can reception answer whether a document is legally binding?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: No, that requires the lawyer's assessment of the document and context.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: The form has a space for an organization, but I am calling for myself.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Leave out an organization name if you are not calling for one.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I am Vera Lake. Please have the lawyer call about the sentence marked with a question mark.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Can you read it?

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I do not have it here. I only wanted to ask for a call.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Do I need to sign the blank intake form before asking how to complete it?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: You can ask reception about the form without signing it during this call.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Soy Inés Ríos. ¿Puedo entregar las páginas en una carpeta?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Sí, recepción puede recibir una carpeta y registrar la entrega.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: The office voicemail sounds different. Have I called another business?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: You have reached this law office's reception desk.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I am Mark Heath. One of the printed instructions is faint.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: I will check whether reception has a clearer printed copy; I have not located one yet.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: My appointment is written in pencil. Does that make it tentative?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: The writing tool alone does not establish booking status. I cannot verify a booking from that detail.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I have several documents in one envelope. Should I list them outside?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: You can attach a contents list for reception, but receipt of the envelope is not verification of that list.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Could I request a consultation about a shop lease for a friend without sharing their documents?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: You can ask about the appointment process; reception cannot establish representation of your friend through this inquiry.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I am Lucy Ford. I have already collected the folder. Please don't look for it.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Understood, you are reporting collection and withdrawing the search request.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: ¿El mensaje confirma una hora exacta o solo la mañana?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Si solo dice por la mañana, no establece una hora exacta.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: The attachment has a password box. Should I send you my password?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Do not give reception a password on this call. We have not accessed the attachment.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I am Peter Cove. Please ask the lawyer about the note on the reverse of the letter.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: I can record that it is on the reverse, but I cannot interpret it here.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Does the reception receipt prove how many attachments were in an email?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: A paper drop-off receipt does not establish the attachments in an email.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: The form asks for previous names. I have never used another name.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: You can indicate that there are no previous names to report.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I am Olive Stone. I want to confirm whether the envelope is ready for collection.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: I will check the collection shelf; I cannot confirm readiness before that check.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Can I arrive with a suitcase because I am coming from the station?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Reception cannot promise storage for luggage. Please arrange your belongings accordingly.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: My copy is in black and white. Do you need color?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: I cannot determine whether color matters without the lawyer's document request.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Soy Pablo Sol. ¿Puedo dejar una pregunta por escrito en recepción?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Sí, puede dejar una nota; eso no confirma cuándo recibirá una respuesta.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I called about a receipt number, but found it while waiting.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Then you have the number you needed.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Yes, no further question.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I am Tess Harbor. Please have the lawyer explain whether the draft is the latest version.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: I do not have a version decision at reception. That remains a question for the lawyer.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Can an email auto-reply be treated as the lawyer's answer?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: An automatic receipt does not provide a substantive answer from the lawyer.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I have a torn envelope but the pages look intact.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Keep the envelope with the pages so the lawyer can see what you received.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: The reminder has my initial only. Is that enough to know it is mine?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: An initial alone may not identify the intended recipient; I cannot confirm that from the initial.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I am Miles Ash. I need someone to check whether the copied last page is readable.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: I will ask reception to inspect the copy quality; that is separate from reviewing its meaning.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: ¿Puedo usar una copia del formulario que ya tengo?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Si es el formulario en blanco actual, recepción puede ayudarle a comprobar el título; no lo hemos comparado todavía.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Is the office directory downstairs enough to find you?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Look for the law office name on the directory, then come to reception.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I am Ruby Lane. Please ask about a second consultation after I find the missing papers.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: You are asking about a possible later appointment, not booking one now?

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Yes.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Can I bring the envelope unopened?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Reception can accept a sealed envelope. That does not mean staff have checked what is inside.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I was told to keep the original. Does that mean I cannot bring it to show the lawyer?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: I cannot interpret that earlier instruction without its context; keeping and showing are not the same action.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Soy Rosa Mar. ¿Una cita solicitada ya aparece como confirmada?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Solicitarla no equivale a confirmarla. No hemos confirmado una cita en esta llamada.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I am Jay Linden. The attachment title says draft, but the email does not.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Please ask the lawyer which version is intended.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Please have him call me about that.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: The questionnaire has a second contact field. Is another contact compulsory?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: The form marks that field optional.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I see the optional label now.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Can I ask for an appointment without describing private details to reception?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: You can ask about the process without giving a full account on this call.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: My name is Mina Grove. The receipt has yesterday's date even though I came today.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: I will ask reception to check the entry; I cannot say the receipt has been corrected yet.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Is there a water fountain near reception?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: There is drinking water in the waiting area.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I have a page with no heading. Should I write a title on it?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Keep it as received and explain the missing heading to the lawyer rather than guessing a title.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: ¿Recepción puede confirmar que mi correo no se fue a spam?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: No tenemos una comprobación del buzón aquí, así que no puedo confirmarlo.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I am Ben Elm. Please ask the lawyer what the handwritten arrow means.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: I cannot see the annotation.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I will have it in front of me when he calls.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: The address on my old form differs from the new letterhead.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Use the current letterhead for the office mailing address; this does not change the address written in your older document.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I want an appointment for information only, not to sign anything today.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: You can state that when requesting the consultation. No signing has happened in this call.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I am Faye Holt. I no longer need a paper copy; the electronic one is readable.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Understood. You are withdrawing the paper-copy request.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Does the reception log include when the lawyer takes an envelope upstairs?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: This log records incoming handovers only. It does not establish later internal movement.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Soy Luis Prado. ¿Puedo traer una lista de preguntas para no olvidarlas?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Sí, puede llevar su lista a la consulta.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I am Gail Pine. The envelope collection note lists the wrong color.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: I will compare the note with the stored envelope before giving you a collection confirmation.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: If the lawyer is unavailable, should I leave the same question again?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: You can clarify an earlier message; repetition alone does not show it has been read.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I have a consultation question about a neighbor's shared driveway, but only know a nickname.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Do not guess a full name in the inquiry. Mark the identifying information as incomplete.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Can reception stamp the date on my own copy at drop-off?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: You can request a receipt at handover; reception must see what is being received first.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I am Rowan Vale. Please have the lawyer explain whether the first draft should be kept.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: I cannot decide document retention from reception.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: That is why I would like a call.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: ¿Si falta una página, debo inventar lo que decía?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: No. Indique que falta y conserve las páginas que tiene.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I took a photo of the appointment card. The bottom is blurred.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: A blurred photo cannot establish the missing wording. Keep the physical card if you still have it.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: My name is Kit Reed. I am checking whether reception has a large-print blank form.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: I will check our printed stock; I cannot promise that format until I look.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Is there a separate line to ask general opening-hour questions?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: You can ask reception those questions on this line.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: The file name ends in final-final. Does that prove it is approved?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: A file name alone does not establish approval by the lawyer.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I am Asha Green. Please ask the lawyer to call about a paragraph that refers to an attachment I never received.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Which attachment?

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: The paragraph does not name it clearly.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Soy Eva Sierra. ¿Puedo traer las hojas ordenadas como las recibí?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Sí, mantenga ese orden y explique si cree que falta algo.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: The form asks for the best time to call. Can I write a range?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Yes, you can state a range; that is a preference, not a guaranteed callback time.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I am Theo Marsh. I asked about parking, but I have decided to walk.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Then you no longer need the parking information.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Correct.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Can I show the lawyer a message on my phone instead of printing it?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: You can ask at the consultation. Reception cannot decide whether that format will be sufficient.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: The note says bring identification. Does a photocopy satisfy that?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: I cannot determine what the lawyer intended from that short instruction alone.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I am Orla Bay. One corner of my receipt is missing.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: I will ask reception whether the logged receipt can be matched before offering another copy.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: ¿Puedo preguntar el proceso de consulta aunque aún no tenga documentos?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Sí, puede preguntar el proceso; no hemos evaluado su asunto en esta llamada.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: The appointment card says bring notes if available. I have none.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: The phrase if available does not say you must create notes you do not have.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I am Finn Dale. Please have the lawyer explain why the date on the cover differs from the signature page.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: I cannot resolve that discrepancy from reception.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I found a second envelope addressed to me. Should I assume it replaces the first?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Do not assume replacement just because another envelope arrived. Keep both available for clarification.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Can I borrow a pen when completing the form at reception?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: There are pens at the reception desk.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Soy Alma Nieve. La dirección ya se ve bien en la copia nueva.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Entonces la copia nueva resolvió el problema de lectura.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Sí, gracias.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I am Drew Clay. Please ask whether my written question was included with the folder.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: I cannot confirm folder contents from the receipt alone.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: The instructions say bring any relevant correspondence. Can reception decide what is relevant?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Reception cannot make that judgment about your matter. Keep the instructions for discussion with the lawyer.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I printed the blank form at half size. The text is readable to me.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Reception cannot confirm that the reduced form is suitable for the lawyer's use.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I am Esme Flint. The courier left a delivery photo but the label is hidden.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: I will compare the available reception record; the photo alone does not identify your envelope.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Does the office website contact form guarantee a same-day reply?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: I have no same-day response guarantee to give you from reception.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: ¿Una copia borrosa cuenta como información confirmada?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: No podemos confirmar palabras que no se leen con claridad.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: My name is Cam North. I need the lawyer to call about the blank space before my name.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: I cannot tell whether that space should be completed without the document context.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: The reminder says reply only if you cannot attend. I can attend.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: That instruction does not ask for a reply from someone who can attend.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Can I bring a typed list instead of handwritten questions?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Yes, you may bring typed questions to the appointment.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I am Sylvie Reed. I have the receipt in my hand now; please disregard my earlier question about losing it.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Understood, you are reporting that it has been found.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Does an envelope marked personal skip the reception log?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Reception cannot promise to bypass the delivery record based on an envelope marking.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Soy Nico Alba. ¿Puedo escribir desconocido si no sé una fecha?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Sí, no adivine una fecha que no conoce.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I am Eden Birch. Please ask the lawyer whether the unsigned version is still useful.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: That is a document question for the lawyer, not something reception can decide.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I have a consultation request but may be away next week.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Give reception your availability when you request a slot; this call has not reserved one.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: The reception receipt uses an abbreviation I cannot read.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: I cannot expand an unclear abbreviation without seeing the receipt.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I am Jules Moss. Please check whether the smaller envelope is still with the folder.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: I will compare the folder handover record; I have not inspected the contents.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Could you clarify whether reception handles appointment questions or the lawyer does?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Reception can discuss the schedule; legal questions about your matter remain for the lawyer.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: ¿Puedo traer el sobre con el sello postal?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Sí, consérvelo junto con la carta para que el abogado vea lo recibido.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I found two reminders for the same date but different rooms.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: That conflict needs a calendar check. The reminders alone do not tell us which room is correct.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I am Rae Wood. Please have the lawyer explain the word enclosure on the last line.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: I can note that word, but cannot identify the intended enclosure from reception.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Can reception confirm whether a scanned signature is acceptable?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: That depends on the document and purpose; reception cannot approve it from this question alone.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: My appointment instructions were folded and the middle line is unreadable.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Do not infer the missing words. Bring the damaged instructions when asking for clarification.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I am Zoe Vale. The replacement printout has all the margins now.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Then the printing problem you described has been resolved.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Yes, nothing else is needed.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Soy Sara Olmo. ¿Recepción puede decir si debo firmar hoy?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: No puedo indicarle que firme ni inventar un plazo; esa pregunta es para el abogado.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I am Max Fen. Please ask about the difference between the attachment I received Monday and today's one.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: I cannot compare versions from reception without the documents.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Does a request for a receipt imply that the lawyer agrees with the document?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: No. A receipt records delivery, not agreement with the contents.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Can I leave a short note with my preferred pronunciation?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Yes, you can include that with the intake form.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I am Lena Ridge. The receipt copy has a blank where the count should be.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: I will ask reception to check the logged count before answering how many items were recorded.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: ¿Si no conozco el número de página, puedo describir el párrafo?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Sí, describa lo que puede leer sin inventar un número.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I want to know whether I can ask about a consultation on a freelance contract next month.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Reception can explain the request process; we have not booked a next-month appointment here.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I am Neil Cove. I no longer need directions; a friend showed me the office.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Understood, the directions question is answered.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: The letter says see attached, but there is no attachment listed.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: That is an unresolved reference; reception cannot invent the missing attachment.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I am Mara Field. Please ask the lawyer whether the two dates refer to different events.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: I cannot assign meanings to those dates without the letter.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I will keep it for the callback.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Can reception confirm how long a consultation will last from a starting time alone?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: A starting time alone does not establish duration.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Soy Dani Valle. ¿Puedo pedir que repitan una instrucción que no entendí?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Sí, diga qué parte no entendió; no es necesario fingir que quedó clara.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I am Arlo Lake. Could someone verify that my loose receipt stayed with the envelope?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: I will check the handover note; I cannot say the receipt is inside until that is checked.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: I have a blank form labeled optional supplement. Must everyone complete it?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: The optional label does not say everyone must complete it. Ask about your specific use at the consultation.

segments.speaker: outside_caller
segments.text: Can I bring a magnifier to read my papers during the appointment?

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Yes, you may bring your reading aid.
